title: Ozone-depleting chemicals: phased out vs still in use (percent)

source.name: WMO Bulletin on ozone layer recovery

notes: The Montreal Protocol (1987) has achieved phase-out of nearly 99% of the banned ozone-depleting substances (CFCs and related chemicals) it controls, per the WMO's ozone bulletin; the remaining ~1% reflects substances still in permitted use or residual atmospheric banks.
